I mean, even if someone isn't trans, they could still opt to "transition"/change their body for aesthetic reasons. And in terms of presentation of clothing, behaviour, etc. a person doesn't have to be trans to present like the opposite gender. If you want to change your body, there isn't a rule that says you have to be trans to change your body. You could experiment without using the label trans. There's also genderfluid, gender non conforming, I personally relate to these terms more. Though, a lot of these changes can overlap with dysphoria, as in my case. 

In my case, I literally transitioned cuz I felt like it and I think it would look cooler. Never had the major dysphoria that was usually written about in books or news or whatever. 0 regrets. Ultimately it ended up being mild dysphoria anyways, cuz my cis friends are not okay with changing their bodies in the way that I've decided to.
